name: Smart Money Concepts (SMC) [LuxAlgo]
license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (LuxAlgo's standard open-source header; not shown on page, not re-verified per script)
what_it_does: All-in-one SMC markup: automates internal and swing market structure (BOS/CHoCH), order blocks, equal highs/lows, fair value gaps, multi-timeframe previous highs/lows and premium/discount zones. The most boosted indicator on TradingView (LuxAlgo cites ~165k boosts).
core_math: Two pivot layers: a short-lookback 'internal' swing detector and a long-lookback 'swing' detector. A close/cross beyond the last swing high/low is labelled BOS if it agrees with the current structure trend, CHoCH if it flips it. Order blocks are taken at the candle preceding the structure break around the swing (exact candle-selection/volatility filter not described on the page); OBs are removed once price trades through them (mitigated). FVGs use the 3-bar gap definition with an optional 'Auto Threshold' filter; EQH/EQL are swing points at near-equal prices confirmed after N 'Bars Confirmation'. Premium/discount = zones of the current swing range (top = premium, bottom = discount, middle = equilibrium). Exact pivot lengths and thresholds not stated on the public page.
outputs: BOS/CHoCH labels and lines (internal + swing), OB boxes (default last 5), EQH/EQL labels, FVG boxes, daily/weekly/monthly high/low levels, premium/equilibrium/discount zones, candle coloring by trend, alerts. Newer library version adds a 'Confluence Score' (weighted trend bias, HTF alignment, zone proximity, sweeps).
timeframes: any; historical vs present-only display modes
repaints: conditional - pivots/swings are only confirmed after the right-side lookback bars, so structure labels are placed retroactively; break events themselves fire in real time
weaknesses: Author states there is no supporting data for the validity of SMC concepts; swing-level labels lag by the pivot length; many objects clutter chart; OB definition is a heuristic.

name: ICT Concepts [LuxAlgo]
license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (LuxAlgo's standard open-source header; not shown on page, not re-verified per script)
what_it_does: Toolkit bundling Inner Circle Trader concepts: market structure (MSS/BOS), order and breaker blocks, imbalances (FVG, IFVG, BPR, volume imbalance, opening gap), buyside/sellside liquidity, displacement, killzones, NWOG/NDOG and Fibonacci between features.
core_math: MSS = break of a swing low in an uptrend (or swing high in a downtrend); BOS = break in trend direction; swing length set by 'Length'. Displacement = run of same-direction candles with large bodies and short shadows. OBs from swing lookback, converted to breakers when mitigated. FVG = 3-candle pattern whose outer shadows do not overlap; IFVG variant built from averages of shadow and body extremities when shadows overlap; BPR = overlap of opposing FVGs; VI = open/close gaps with trading overlap; OG = true gap with no overlap. Liquidity: pivots are grouped when within a margin of (10-bar ATR / (10/margin)). Killzones are fixed ET windows (NY 7-9, London open 2-5, London close 10-12, Asia from 20:00).
outputs: MSS/BOS lines, OB/breaker boxes, imbalance boxes, liquidity boxes (max 50/side), displacement highlights, killzone background, NWOG/NDOG boxes, Fibonacci levels.
timeframes: intraday for killzones; structure any TF
repaints: conditional - pivots/swings are only confirmed after the right-side lookback bars, so structure labels are placed retroactively; break events themselves fire in real time
weaknesses: Many overlapping heuristics; present mode limited to last 500 bars; displacement and liquidity definitions are discretionary-inspired.

name: Market Structure CHoCH/BOS (Fractal) [LuxAlgo]
license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (LuxAlgo's standard open-source header; not shown on page, not re-verified per script)
what_it_does: Experimental market-structure tool that builds CHoCH/BOS from fractal patterns instead of classic swing points. Optionally draws the resulting support/resistance with breakouts and a dashboard with structure-to-fractal percentages.
core_math: Bullish fractal: lows decreasing into a central candle then increasing after it; bearish fractal: highs increasing into the centre then decreasing. The latest fractal high/low becomes the structure level; a break against the current trend is CHoCH, a break with it is BOS.
outputs: CHoCH/BOS labels and lines, optional S/R levels with break markers, dashboard of structure/fractal ratio.
repaints: conditional - pivots/swings are only confirmed after the right-side lookback bars, so structure labels are placed retroactively; break events themselves fire in real time
weaknesses: Fractal requires right-side bars (lag); experimental per author.

name: Pure Price Action Structures [LuxAlgo]
license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (LuxAlgo's standard open-source header; not shown on page, not re-verified per script)
what_it_does: Parameter-free market structure: detects short-, intermediate- and long-term swing highs/lows purely from price, then labels MSS/CHoCH and BOS for each tier.
core_math: Short-term swing high = a high with lower highs on both sides (swing low analogous); intermediate swings are derived from the short-term swing sequence and long-term from the intermediate sequence (hierarchical swing-of-swings; exact rule not spelled out). Breaks of each tier's last swing are classified as shift (against trend) or break (with trend).
outputs: Tiered swing labels (ST/IT/LT), MSS/BOS lines per tier.
repaints: conditional - author: swing points are not identified in real time; short-term up to 1 bar delay, intermediate/long-term depend on later price action
weaknesses: Higher tiers can be confirmed many bars late; no tuning knobs.

name: Market Structure Oscillator [LuxAlgo]
license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (LuxAlgo's standard open-source header; not shown on page, not re-verified per script)
what_it_does: Turns short-, intermediate- and long-term market-structure events into oscillators, plus a cycle histogram, to show structural trend momentum.
core_math: Uses the same hierarchical swing detection as Pure Price Action Structures (ST swing = peak with lower highs each side; IT from ST swings, LT from IT swings). MSS/BOS events per tier are normalized and combined with user weights into one oscillator, then smoothed; a cycle oscillator histogram is derived from the oscillator relative to its average ('Cycle Signal Length').
outputs: Three per-tier oscillators, combined oscillator, cycle histogram, structure drawn on price.
repaints: conditional - pivots/swings are only confirmed after the right-side lookback bars, so structure labels are placed retroactively; break events themselves fire in real time
weaknesses: Exact normalization not described; inherits swing confirmation lag.

name: Market Structure Trailing Stop [LuxAlgo]
license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (LuxAlgo's standard open-source header; not shown on page, not re-verified per script)
what_it_does: Trailing stop that resets on market-structure events (CHoCH only, or CHoCH + BOS) and then ratchets toward price.
core_math: Pivot swings (Pivot Lookback) define structure. On a new structure event the stop is initialised at the extreme (max/min) of the previous trend leg and a trailing max/min is reset to current price; thereafter the stop converges toward price by an 'Increment Factor %' of the distance between the trailing extreme and the stop.
outputs: Trailing stop line colored by direction, optional CHoCH/BOS labels.
repaints: conditional - pivots/swings are only confirmed after the right-side lookback bars, so structure labels are placed retroactively; break events themselves fire in real time
weaknesses: Resets depend on lagged pivots; convergence speed is a free parameter.

name: kNN Market Architecture [LuxAlgo]
license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (LuxAlgo's standard open-source header; not shown on page, not re-verified per script)
what_it_does: Market-structure framework that uses a k-nearest-neighbours classifier to validate candidate pivots at short, medium and long horizons, with volatility-adaptive detection windows, delta labels and an anchored volume profile.
core_math: For each candidate pivot, features (relative ATR, relative volume) are compared with a stored database of previous pivots; the pivot is accepted only if its k nearest neighbours pass a confidence threshold. The pivot detection window expands in high volatility and contracts in low volatility. Candle bias = above recent validated highs (bull) / below lows (bear).
outputs: Validated ST/MT/LT pivots, 'Delta Tank' cumulative volume delta labels, bias candle colors, anchored volume profile of current range.
repaints: conditional - pivots/swings are only confirmed after the right-side lookback bars, so structure labels are placed retroactively; break events themselves fire in real time
weaknesses: Label definition for kNN training not described publicly; small feature set.

name: Order Blocks & Breaker Blocks [LuxAlgo]
license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (LuxAlgo's standard open-source header; not shown on page, not re-verified per script)
what_it_does: Detects order blocks from swing points and converts them into breaker blocks once mitigated (polarity flip: support becomes resistance and vice versa).
core_math: Swings via 'Swing Lookback'; when price breaks a swing, the OB is the relevant candle range (full range or body if 'Use Candle Body') near the swing extreme. When price later mitigates the OB it becomes a breaker block, expected to be retested from the other side.
outputs: Solid OB boxes, dashed dual-color breaker boxes, optional historical polarity change labels.
repaints: conditional - OBs/breakers are real-time given swing confirmation; historical polarity labels are backpainted (author)
weaknesses: Exact OB candle selection not detailed on page; zone quality heuristic.

name: Fair Value Gap [LuxAlgo]
license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (LuxAlgo's standard open-source header; not shown on page, not re-verified per script)
what_it_does: Detects bullish/bearish fair value gaps, tracks their mitigation and reports the percentage of gaps filled and average bars to fill.
core_math: Bullish FVG: low > high[2] AND close[1] > high[2] AND (low - high[2])/high[2] > threshold. Bearish: high < low[2] AND close[1] < low[2] AND (low[2]-high)/high < -threshold. Auto threshold = cumulative mean of relative FVG heights. Gap is mitigated when price trades back through its far extremity.
outputs: FVG boxes, unmitigated/mitigated levels, dashboard (fill %, average fill duration), fill alerts.
repaints: no - pattern confirmed on bar close using only past bars (HTF option may lag until HTF bar closes)
weaknesses: Author frames it both as contrarian (fill = reversal) and trend (new FVG = entry) - no single tested rule.

name: Inversion Fair Value Gaps (IFVG) [LuxAlgo]
license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (LuxAlgo's standard open-source header; not shown on page, not re-verified per script)
what_it_does: Tracks FVGs that are closed through in the opposite direction (inverted), which then act as zones of the opposite polarity, with signals on retests.
core_math: FVGs larger than ATR * 'ATR Multiplier' are tracked; when price closes beyond the FVG against its bias it becomes an IFVG (bullish FVG -> resistance, bearish -> support). Signals fire on interaction using wick or close ('Signal Preference'); the IFVG is deleted once price mitigates it.
outputs: IFVG boxes, midlines, signal markers (last up to 100).
repaints: conditional - author: historical signals are not valid for backtesting because deleted (mitigated) IFVGs vanish from history
weaknesses: Deletion of mitigated zones biases visual history.

name: Imbalance Detector [LuxAlgo]
license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (LuxAlgo's standard open-source header; not shown on page, not re-verified per script)
what_it_does: Detects three imbalance types - fair value gaps, opening gaps and volume imbalances - with a dashboard of frequency and fill percentage.
core_math: FVG: gap between current low and high two bars back (bull) or current high and low two bars back (bear). Opening gap: current bar's range does not overlap prior bar. Volume imbalance: gap between consecutive candle bodies while wicks overlap. Fill tracked when price returns into the gap.
outputs: Imbalance boxes per type, dashboard (count, fill %), alerts.
repaints: no - three-bar/two-bar patterns confirmed on close
weaknesses: Descriptive statistics only; no directional edge claimed.

name: Liquidity Voids (FVG) [LuxAlgo]
license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (LuxAlgo's standard open-source header; not shown on page, not re-verified per script)
what_it_does: Highlights liquidity voids (long-range thin-trading moves derived from FVG logic) and their distribution across price, showing fill status.
core_math: Voids derived from fair-value-gap detection; optional filter compares void width with a fixed-length ATR times 'Liquidity Voids Threshold' (0 = no filter). A void is filled when price returns to the gap origin.
outputs: Void boxes/bars across price levels, labels, filled voids toggle.
repaints: no - based on closed-bar gaps (not stated explicitly by author)
weaknesses: Assumes voids 'almost always fill' - no statistics given.

name: Buyside & Sellside Liquidity [LuxAlgo]
license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (LuxAlgo's standard open-source header; not shown on page, not re-verified per script)
what_it_does: Marks ICT buyside (above highs, shorts' stops) and sellside (below lows, longs' stops) liquidity levels, creates zones when they are swept, and flags liquidity voids.
core_math: Pivot highs/lows over 'Detection Length' that cluster within a margin (ICT Concepts version: 10-bar ATR/(10/margin)) form a liquidity level. When price trades through the level a zone is created; a reversal toward the opposite pool is expected, while breaking the zone implies continuation. Voids = one or more same-direction candles with large bodies and short wicks.
outputs: Liquidity level lines, breach zones, liquidity void boxes/labels.
repaints: conditional - pivots/swings are only confirmed after the right-side lookback bars, so structure labels are placed retroactively; break events themselves fire in real time
weaknesses: Margin/clustering exact formula not shown on this page; conflicting interpretations (reversal vs continuation) left to user.

name: Liquidity Swings [LuxAlgo]
license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (LuxAlgo's standard open-source header; not shown on page, not re-verified per script)
what_it_does: Highlights swing-high/low areas where trading activity accumulated: counts how often price revisited each swing zone and sums the volume traded inside it.
core_math: Pivot highs/lows (Pivot Lookback). Swing zone = wick extremity (high to max(open,close) for highs) or full candle range. While the zone is unbroken, each bar trading into it increments a touch count and adds its volume (optional intrabar precision). Zones below a count or volume threshold are filtered. Breaking a swing high = bullish, swing low = bearish.
outputs: Swing zones with count, volume labels, swing lines.
timeframes: any; author notes lower-TF accumulation/distribution use
repaints: conditional - author: not real-time by nature; pivots appear after the lookback
weaknesses: Descriptive only; pivot labels not meant to be traded in real time.

name: Swing Failure Pattern (SFP) [LuxAlgo]
license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (LuxAlgo's standard open-source header; not shown on page, not re-verified per script)
what_it_does: Detects swing failure patterns - wicks that pierce a recent swing level but close back inside - as liquidity-grab reversal setups, with a confirmation level.
core_math: Swing highs/lows from pivots. Bearish SFP: high > swing high but close < swing high (bullish mirror). Optional volume % threshold filter (share of volume beyond the swing, per settings). Confirmation level = lowest low (bearish) / highest high (bullish) between the swing and the SFP; a break of it confirms reversal.
outputs: SFP labels, accentuated wick lines, confirmation level line.
repaints: conditional - pivots/swings are only confirmed after the right-side lookback bars, so structure labels are placed retroactively; break events themselves fire in real time
weaknesses: Volume filter details depend on intrabar data availability; SFPs frequent in trends.

name: Support and Resistance Levels with Breaks [LuxAlgo]
license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (LuxAlgo's standard open-source header; not shown on page, not re-verified per script)
what_it_does: Plots pivot-based support/resistance and labels breaks, keeping only breaks confirmed by a volume oscillator above a threshold; also flags wick-dominated breaks.
core_math: Pivot high/low with Left Bars/Right Bars defines the level. Break = close beyond the level; 'B' label only if the Volume Oscillator (short vs long EMA of volume, % difference) exceeds 'Volume Threshold'. Breaks on candles with a large opposing wick get 'Bull Wick'/'Bear Wick' tags.
outputs: S/R step lines, B / Bull Wick / Bear Wick labels, alerts.
repaints: conditional - pivots/swings are only confirmed after the right-side lookback bars, so structure labels are placed retroactively; break events themselves fire in real time
weaknesses: Volume oscillator EMA lengths are not stated on the page; single last pivot only.

name: Pivot Points High Low & Missed Reversal Levels [LuxAlgo]
license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (LuxAlgo's standard open-source header; not shown on page, not re-verified per script)
what_it_does: Standard window pivots plus 'missed reversals': when two same-type pivots occur consecutively, the skipped opposite extreme is inserted and turned into a level; a zig-zag links them.
core_math: Pivot high/low = bar that is highest/lowest within the Pivot Length window. If two consecutive pivots are of the same type, the extreme of the opposite type between them is flagged as a missed reversal and plotted as a level. Zig-zag connects regular pivots and missed reversals.
outputs: Pivot labels, ghost-labelled missed reversals, S/R levels, zig-zag.
repaints: conditional - pivots/swings are only confirmed after the right-side lookback bars, so structure labels are placed retroactively; break events themselves fire in real time
weaknesses: Missed reversals are by definition found late.

name: Predictive Ranges [LuxAlgo]
license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (LuxAlgo's standard open-source header; not shown on page, not re-verified per script)
what_it_does: Projects a future trading range (central level plus upper/lower levels) that is reset in real time whenever price exits it; the central level's slope indicates trend. Former 2020 premium feature released open-source.
core_math: Range width driven by ATR(Length) * Factor. A central estimate of price is held constant while price stays within its ATR band and is shifted toward price when price moves beyond it; two levels above and below the centre are derived from the same ATR distance (exact number/spacing of levels not stated on page).
outputs: Centre line and upper/lower range levels (R1/R2, S1/S2 style), trend via centre slope.
repaints: no - author: new levels are given in real time when price exits the range and do not repaint
weaknesses: Constant ranges in strong trends reset frequently.

name: Range Detector [LuxAlgo]
license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (LuxAlgo's standard open-source header; not shown on page, not re-verified per script)
what_it_does: Detects consolidation ranges and highlights their extremities, coloring breakouts.
core_math: Over a window of 'Minimum Range Length' bars, a range is detected when every price lies within mean(window) +/- ATR(ATR Length) * Range Width. The range box then extends until a new range is detected; extremity color turns green/red when broken up/down.
outputs: Range boxes, midline, detection-bar background, breakout coloring.
repaints: conditional - ranges are drawn retrospectively (start point offset into the past) though detection moment is real-time
weaknesses: Fixed ATR band; ranges can overlap trends in low volatility.

name: Supply and Demand Visible Range [LuxAlgo]
license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (LuxAlgo's standard open-source header; not shown on page, not re-verified per script)
what_it_does: Builds supply (top) and demand (bottom) areas for the currently visible chart range using a volume-accumulation method with intrabar data.
core_math: The visible range is split into 'Resolution' bins; starting from the top (supply) and bottom (demand) extremes, bins are accumulated until their volume reaches 'Threshold %' of total visible volume, defining each area. Plots the area average and volume-weighted average, and the midpoint between them.
outputs: Supply/demand boxes, average and weighted-average lines, equilibrium line.
repaints: yes - recalculates whenever the visible range changes; author calls it descriptive
weaknesses: Not usable for backtesting or live signals.

name: Trendlines with Breaks [LuxAlgo]
license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (LuxAlgo's standard open-source header; not shown on page, not re-verified per script)
what_it_does: Draws pivot-anchored trendlines whose slope is set by a volatility measure, and marks real-time breakouts.
core_math: From each new pivot high (low), a descending (ascending) line is projected with slope proportional to a volatility measure scaled by the Slope multiplier (volatility/Length * Slope per the open source, not stated on page), where the volatility measure is ATR (default), standard deviation, or linear-regression based. A close crossing the projected line triggers a 'B' breakout.
outputs: Upper/lower trendlines, B break labels, alerts.
repaints: conditional - breakout labels are not repainted/backpainted; trendline drawings are backpainted (offset to pivot) unless disabled
weaknesses: Slope is synthetic (volatility-based), not fitted to actual touches. ~52k favorites.

name: Trend Lines [LuxAlgo]
license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (LuxAlgo's standard open-source header; not shown on page, not re-verified per script)
what_it_does: Classic swing-to-swing trendlines (lower highs, higher lows) with validity filters, break detection and angle estimation, designed for real-time use.
core_math: Swing = high/low that is highest/lowest against Length bars on both sides. Bearish line joins two lower swing highs, bullish joins two higher swing lows. Optional validation that no close breaks the line between point A and B (or A to current bar). A solid extension continues bar-by-bar; a break is counted only after the line was uninterrupted for 'Minimal bars'. Angle computed with user X-Y ratio and filterable by min/max degrees.
outputs: Dotted confirmed trendlines, solid live extensions, break labels, angle labels.
repaints: conditional - pivots/swings are only confirmed after the right-side lookback bars, so structure labels are placed retroactively; break events themselves fire in real time
weaknesses: Angle depends on chart scaling ratio; lagged swings.

name: Machine Learning Trendlines Cluster [LuxAlgo]
license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (LuxAlgo's standard open-source header; not shown on page, not re-verified per script)
what_it_does: Finds multiple trendlines by clustering prices with k-means and fitting a linear regression to each cluster.
core_math: Prices over a window are partitioned into k clusters (user sets number of trendlines); a linear regression is fitted to the points of each cluster, giving one trendline per cluster; lines can be filtered by slope (remove too-flat or keep only flat).
outputs: k trendlines extended to the right.
repaints: unknown - rolling window refit implies lines change each bar
weaknesses: Clusters of price values are not necessarily meaningful trend structures.

name: Market Flow Trend Lines & Liquidity [LuxAlgo]
license: proprietary (closed-source, free to use)
what_it_does: Closed-source but free breakout-trader toolkit: multi-timeframe trendlines, liquidity zones, opening ranges and gaps.
core_math: not public: claims automated MTF trendlines, key liquidity zones for entries, opening ranges and gaps
outputs: Trendlines, liquidity zones, opening range and gap markings.
repaints: unknown - closed source
weaknesses: Mechanism unverifiable.

name: SuperTrend AI (Clustering) [LuxAlgo]
license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (LuxAlgo's standard open-source header; not shown on page, not re-verified per script)
what_it_does: Runs many SuperTrends over a range of ATR factors, scores each by recent performance, clusters the scores with k-means and uses the average factor of the chosen (best by default) cluster.
core_math: For factors min..max by step, compute SuperTrend (shared ATR length). Performance per factor = exponential smoothing (memory alpha 0<a<1) of that SuperTrend's hypothetical per-bar return (price change signed by its direction - sign convention from the open source, page only gives the EMA form). K-means with k=3 (worst/average/best), centroids initialized at quartiles, iterated up to a max step count over the historical window. Final factor = mean factor of the selected cluster; a performance index of the chosen cluster drives an adaptive MA of the trailing stop (exact normalization not on page).
outputs: Adaptive SuperTrend trailing stop, its adaptive MA, signals labelled with a performance score (low values ~ retracement, high ~ trend).
repaints: no - computed on past bars only (not explicitly claimed by author; standard SuperTrend flips confirm on close)
weaknesses: Performance-chasing: optimum factor adapts after regime change; heavy computation.

name: KNN Supertrend Horizon [LuxAlgo]
license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (LuxAlgo's standard open-source header; not shown on page, not re-verified per script)
what_it_does: SuperTrend whose trend state is determined by a k-nearest-neighbours classifier over RSI and ATR-volatility features, with confidence-graded candle colors and 'rejection orbs'.
core_math: Features: current RSI and ATR-based volatility. Over a 'Search Window' of past bars, find the K closest feature vectors; their trend labels vote on the current trend state, filtering the standard SuperTrend. Vote share = confidence, mapped to color intensity. Exhaustion 'Rejection Orbs' mark price rejections of the band.
outputs: SuperTrend line, confidence-colored candles, rejection orbs, dashboard.
repaints: unknown - not stated
weaknesses: Neighbour labels definition not detailed on page; 2-feature space is small.

name: Evasive SuperTrend [LuxAlgo]
license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (LuxAlgo's standard open-source header; not shown on page, not re-verified per script)
what_it_does: SuperTrend variant that pushes its band away from price when price comes too close during noise, to reduce whipsaw flips.
core_math: Standard ATR(Length)*Base Multiplier band. If |price - band| < Noise Threshold * ATR, the band is shifted further away by Expansion Alpha * ATR ('evasive mode', drawn dotted).
outputs: SuperTrend line (solid/dotted), BULL/BEAR labels, gradient fill.
repaints: unknown - not stated; likely no on close
weaknesses: Evasion delays genuine reversals.

name: AI Channels (Clustering) [LuxAlgo]
license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (LuxAlgo's standard open-source header; not shown on page, not re-verified per script)
what_it_does: Channel built by rolling k-means clustering of recent prices; breaking the upper/lower extremity signals trend. Can display as trailing stop.
core_math: Over the last 'Window Size' prices run k-means with user 'Clusters' count; upper extremity = centroid of highest cluster, lower = lowest cluster, middle = average cluster. 'Denoise' smooths centroids.
outputs: Upper/middle/lower channel or trailing stop, trend coloring.
repaints: no - rolling window on past data (not explicitly stated)
weaknesses: More clusters widen extremes; centroids jump without denoise.

name: Nadaraya-Watson Envelope [LuxAlgo]
license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (LuxAlgo's standard open-source header; not shown on page, not re-verified per script)
what_it_does: Contrarian envelope around a Gaussian-kernel regression of price; price crossing the envelope is expected to revert.
core_math: Gaussian-kernel Nadaraya-Watson estimate with 'Bandwidth'. Envelope = estimate +/- Mult * mean absolute deviation of price from the estimate. Repainting mode fits the full two-sided estimator over a window; non-repainting mode uses an endpoint (causal) estimator.
outputs: Upper/lower envelope, triangles on crosses, alerts.
repaints: yes by default (two-sided kernel re-fits past values); non-repainting endpoint option available
weaknesses: Default repainting mode looks far better on history than live; author has no performance data vs classic bands.

name: Nadaraya-Watson Smoothers [LuxAlgo]
license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (LuxAlgo's standard open-source header; not shown on page, not re-verified per script)
what_it_does: Kernel-regression smoother (Gaussian kernel) of price, usable as trend line; formerly 'Nadaraya-Watson Estimator'.
core_math: Weighted average of past prices with Gaussian weights exp(-d^2/(2h^2)) where h = bandwidth; smoothness set by bandwidth not window length. Repainting mode = full estimator; non-repainting = endpoint estimator behaving like a causal MA.
outputs: Smoothed line with direction color change markers.
repaints: conditional - repaints only when 'Repainting Smoothing' enabled
weaknesses: Repainting mode unusable for signals.

name: Machine Learning: Gaussian Process Regression [LuxAlgo]
license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (LuxAlgo's standard open-source header; not shown on page, not re-verified per script)
what_it_does: Applies Gaussian Process Regression to the most recent prices to estimate the trend and forecast it forward.
core_math: GPR over a 'Training Window' of recent prices with a kernel whose length-scale is 'Smooth' and noise level 'Sigma'; posterior mean gives the fitted trend and extrapolated forecast.
outputs: Fitted curve over training window and forecast curve.
repaints: yes - fit and forecast recomputed each bar over the window (description says adapted to real-time use)
weaknesses: Forecasts are extrapolations; not for standalone use (author).

name: Machine Learning Moving Average [LuxAlgo]
license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (LuxAlgo's standard open-source header; not shown on page, not re-verified per script)
what_it_does: Responsive moving average whose weights come from a Gaussian Process Regression weighting function, with bands for reversals.
core_math: Weights derived from GPR with Gaussian kernel (Sigma) over 'Window', with a 'Forecast' setting shifting responsiveness; resulting weights applied as a FIR moving average. Bands = MA +/- multiplicative factor * deviation, crossings mark turning points.
outputs: MA line, upper/lower bands, turning-point markers.
repaints: no - causal weights (not explicitly stated)
weaknesses: Band deviation measure not detailed on page.

name: Machine Learning Regression Trend [LuxAlgo]
license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (LuxAlgo's standard open-source header; not shown on page, not re-verified per script)
what_it_does: Robust linear trend fitted with RANSAC to ignore outliers, extrapolated as a channel.
core_math: Repeat up to Max Iterations: pick 2 random samples in the Length window, fit a line, count inliers whose error is within the allowed error (auto from data scale or fixed); keep model if inliers >= Minimum Inliers; final = model with most inliers. Channel width = user Width.
outputs: Regression line/channel extrapolated, outlier dots, allowed-error margin.
repaints: yes - random sampling and refit on each bar
weaknesses: Random sampling makes outputs non-deterministic.

name: The Echo Forecast [LuxAlgo]
license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (LuxAlgo's standard open-source header; not shown on page, not re-verified per script)
what_it_does: Analogue forecasting: finds the historical price segment most correlated with the recent segment and projects what followed it.
core_math: Within an evaluation window, compute correlation coefficient between the latest 'forecast window' of price changes and every earlier segment of same length; pick the most (or least) similar; append its subsequent changes to current price (Lorenz analogue method).
outputs: Reference segment, matched segment, forecast path.
timeframes: unknown; best on detrended periodic series (author)
repaints: yes - forecast recomputed each bar
weaknesses: Single-analogue forecast, no uncertainty.

name: Indicator Configuration Forecasting [LuxAlgo]
license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (LuxAlgo's standard open-source header; not shown on page, not re-verified per script)
what_it_does: Encodes several indicators into a discrete state vector, finds the K most similar historical states and projects their forward returns as median and quartile paths.
core_math: State vector of +1/-1/0 readings from RSI, SMA cross, SuperTrend, MACD, ADX. KNN search over Historical Lookback for Top K minimal vector distance, avoiding overlapping matches. Forward % returns over horizon N are projected; median (50th), 25th and 75th percentiles plotted.
outputs: Median forecast path and 25-75 percentile bounds.
repaints: yes - projection redrawn each bar
weaknesses: Coarse discrete states; many ties.

name: Trend Regularity Adaptive Moving Average [LuxAlgo]
license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (LuxAlgo's standard open-source header; not shown on page, not re-verified per script)
what_it_does: Exponential MA whose smoothing factor rises with how regularly new highest highs/lowest lows are being made, so it flattens in ranges and hugs price in long trends.
core_math: alpha = (SMA over Length of an indicator that is 1 when a new rolling highest high or lowest low is made)^2; TRAMA = TRAMA[1] + alpha*(src - TRAMA[1]). Squaring penalizes low regularity.
outputs: Single MA line.
repaints: no - causal recursive filter
weaknesses: Lags at trend reversals (author).

name: ATR Exceedance Probability Model [LuxAlgo]
license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (LuxAlgo's standard open-source header; not shown on page, not re-verified per script)
what_it_does: Statistical volatility tool: counts ATR-band exceedances, z-scores their frequency versus a long baseline and classifies Quiet/Normal/High regimes with serial-break (follow-through) probability.
core_math: Exceedance = true range or high/low beyond ATR * multiplier (bands from SMA/EMA basis or bar high/low). Frequency of exceedances compared with a 200-bar baseline via z-score; above sensitivity -> High Vol, below baseline -> contraction. Serial Break % = share of past exceedances followed immediately by another in the same direction.
outputs: ATR bands, regime boxes, z-score oscillator, probability stats.
